# RTE: crowd workers, local LLMs, or both (generated by scripts/run_mixed_panel_rte.py)

800 pairs, gold label, 50% positive. LLM verifiers: local open-weight models, score = log P(Yes) - log P(No) (scripts/label_rte_local.py). Accuracy thresholds: P = 0.5 for probabilities, 0 for majority vote / mean z.

## Single LLM verifiers

| Verifier | AUC | Accuracy at P(Yes) = 0.5 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Meta-Llama-3.1-8B_guide | 93.6 | 83.1 |
| Meta-Llama-3.1-8B_short | 94.1 | 86.1 |
| Qwen3-8B_guide | 96.1 | 88.5 |
| Qwen3-8B_short | 96.3 | 89.6 |
| gemma-3-12b_guide | 96.9 | 89.9 |
| gemma-3-12b_short | 96.6 | 89.1 |

Mean pairwise correlation of LLM scores: 0.87. Paper FUSE (logistic) on the 6 LLMs alone: AUC 97.2, accuracy 90.6.
